# The target ciphertext
target_ct = bytes([0xff, 0xb3, 0x0a, 0xcb, 0xa8, 0x20, 0x8c, 0x98, 0x3f, 0xcd, 0x02, 0x50, 0xf4, 0x68, 0x09, 0xb6, 0x3c, 0x8f, 0xdb, 0x7c, 0xea, 0xd9, 0x6f, 0xbc, 0xbf])

# Reverse the encryption: ct[i] = input[i] ^ (edx & 0xff)
# edx starts at 0xffffffb9, then edx += input[i]

# We need to solve for input[i]:
# ct[i] = input[i] ^ (edx_low & 0xff)
# So: input[i] = ct[i] ^ (edx_low & 0xff)
# Then: edx = edx + input[i]

edx = 0xffffffb9  # Start value (signed -71 as 32-bit, but we treat it as unsigned)
edx = edx & 0xffffffff  # Keep it 32-bit

result = []
for i in range(25):
    edx_low = edx & 0xff
    char = target_ct[i] ^ edx_low
    result.append(char)
    edx = (edx + char) & 0xffffffff

flag = bytes(result)
print(f"Decoded flag: {flag}")
print(f"As string: {flag.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')}")
